claims.statement: For every finite K>2 and every genuine minimum-dimensional ratio core with rho>K, with a_K defined by h2(a_K)=K a_K and lambda_K=log2(1+2^-K)/(K+j'(a_K)), the symbolic surplus satisfies sigma_K(q_i)<=lambda_K(K+j'(q_i)); consequently sum sigma_K d <= lambda_K/2(P-DTC)+lambda_K/4 U_K and the eta=1/16 robust-row load is bounded by 128 lambda_K/105(P-DTC)+64 lambda_K/105 U_K.

For every fixed finite K>2 there are genuine Boolean all-block K-terminal tensor products F_{d,m}, and for all sufficiently large m tensor-primitive one-point surgeries G_{d,m}, with U_K/J tending to infinity. This does not assert ratio-criticality and therefore is not a counterexample to FEI.

For the exact tensor barrier, every cross-factor pair has s=q^2 and omega=4q^2, while the partner I-projection parameter satisfies c>=v, so b=(c/v)q^2>=q^2 and the partner positive-excess charge Psi_b(omega) is exactly zero on the cross-factor bulk.

Use genuine ratio-extremality to eliminate or pay the conditional-product I-projection baseline and construct a realizable nonreused selector for above-baseline excess, while also covering the small/nonrobust branch; terminality and qualitative tensor primitivity alone are insufficient.
